description: Displayed on the terrace of Gjirokastër Castle beside the castle's military museum; surveyed on the ground by an OpenStreetMap contributor who identified it as a Lockheed T-33 Shooting Star; the airframe is the object of a long-standing local account that it was an American spy plane brought down over Albania in the 1950s; it is a US-operated airframe that ended up in Albanian hands rather than an Albanian Air Force aircraft; no serial is published and none is invented here
aliases: T33; T-33A; Shooting Star; T-Bird; T33A
